title: Synthesize the existing-architecture baseline
description: Read returned independent Wave 0 anatomy, rationale and fit accounts. Establish the shared baseline for subsequent execution, action, observation and transfer-policy design. Preserve disagreements and allow baseline findings to reshape epic stubs.
acceptance_criteria: Reviewed as-built map, recovered rationale, strengths, verified limitations and explicit downstream questions; incompatible claims resolved or clearly left open; downstream pointers/dependencies updated.

title: Assess existing architecture against current direction
description: Independently evaluate the present architecture against forward iteration, good-donor assumptions, flexible actions/generated content, component construction and efficient copying. Identify strengths to retain, existing reusable seams and consequential tensions behind faults.
acceptance_criteria: Concrete scenarios distinguish actual limitations from missing exposure or unsettled policy; compares retaining/extending current mechanisms with larger changes without preselecting replacement.

title: Map implemented reconciliation structure and state lifetimes
description: Trace actual listing, admission, observation, action finalization, paired/one-sided traversal, parallel frontier and application. Include JW orchestration and the standalone cursor as consumers. Cite current code and diagrams of data/control/effects ownership.
acceptance_criteria: Code-grounded as-built map explains entrypoints, public/private boundaries, ownership, borrowing, copying, state lifetime, and what is implemented versus proposed; no redesign required.

title: Recover the rationale behind existing architectural choices
description: Read established specifications, earlier design/decision records, reviews and implementation evidence. Explain why the visitor, action constraints, sync split, frontier and native adapter boundaries exist. Distinguish accepted choices, superseded proposals and experiments.
acceptance_criteria: Traceable rationale account identifies problems solved, deliberate constraints, historical assumptions and source/document disagreements without equating newest text with acceptance.

title: Establish the existing reconciliation architecture before redesign
description: Wave 0 recovers and assesses the architecture already implemented across diff-dirs, sync, JW and the isolated cursor specimen. Identify strengths, original rationale and real tensions before proposing new core contracts.
acceptance_criteria: Independent anatomy, rationale and fit accounts produce a shared reviewed baseline; downstream epics are amended where their premises were incomplete.

title: Unify registered missing-workspace identity resolution
description: Owner: jj-waltz. Reproduced on JJ 0.45.1-33d3a595: owned_cleanup_removes_only_target_and_keep_dir_preserves_files fails on remove missing; corresponding prune passes. Inventory loses the missing root path before ownership validation, whose own lookup can recover it.
acceptance_criteria: Shared facts distinguish registration, recorded location, checkout availability and ownership; focused removal/prune/doctor cases agree without weakening external-owner protections.

description: Synthesize independent execution-model, action-protocol, observation-facts and transfer-policy research. Distinguish decisions from remaining alternatives before selecting shared production APIs.
acceptance_criteria: A reviewed account demonstrates compatible ownership/data/control flow across the four domains and records unresolved product choices.

acceptance_criteria: Foundational contracts and open choices recorded; domain epics expanded from evidence; production defaults require deliberate selection.

title: Design proportional verification and bounded measurement
description: Use small semantic fixtures, bounded residency/reuse and explicit setup/run/verification reporting. Support syscall/allocation evidence for dirent work. The cancelled retained-copy campaign is a negative precedent.
acceptance_criteria: A practical experiment template bounds retained data and distinguishes measured operation from verification; no restart of cancelled large workloads.

title: Bind tests to stable executables and source coordinates
description: Owner: jj-waltz and diff-dirs test tooling. Fix mixed runtime/compile-time binary lookup and avoid replacing an executable during a run. Record sibling source revision, features, built CLI and installed JJ.
acceptance_criteria: A run selects stable artifacts and reports its coordinates; Nextest and cargo invocation behavior is consistent without changing the running demo.

title: Isolate native fixture topology and executable delegation
description: Owner: shared tests, especially jj-waltz. Separate repository-free discovery placement from reflink-capable placement; preserve isolated config and avoid mise/interceptor recursion.
acceptance_criteria: Small tests establish no enclosing real-repo discovery, usable real CoW where required, and correct shim delegation; common fixture setup encodes these constraints.

title: Plan command and configuration adoption of generic transfer
description: Owner: jj-waltz. Map chosen mechanisms into add/switch, reseed and prepare, native adapters, compatibility and visible output. Preserve existing empty/disabled selection meanings until explicitly migrated.
acceptance_criteria: Coherent landing proposal follows selected policy/native mechanics and specifies tests and config transition; does not silently turn proposals into defaults.

title: Define copying versus revision advancement and donor-state reuse
description: Owner: jj-waltz. Explain when snapshot auto-tracking changes transfer classification, target identity versus donor tree_state, and S-to-D materialization. Assume good donor; concurrency and locking are out of band.
acceptance_criteria: Account separates plain directory copy from requested graph changes and identifies actual saved JJ work; no new recovery promises.

title: Map Git and JJ metadata preservation and construction
description: Owner: jj-waltz adapter over generic diff-dirs. Study .git directories, gitfiles, linked worktree common/admin state, submodule pointers and .jj binding/cache distinctions. Existing-target preservation differs from new-target initialization.
acceptance_criteria: Topology matrix states what is retained, suppressed, generated or initialized and by whom; tiny fixtures cover representative Git/JJ forms before adapter implementation.

title: Design source-to-many observation and transfer reuse
description: Reuse donor listing/metadata across multiple receiving trees while preserving per-target policy and continuation. Build on single-target lifetime/mode decisions.
acceptance_criteria: Streaming alternatives name retained state, target independence and bounded scheduling; avoid assuming a persistent full-tree catalog.

title: Assess remaining transfer-kernel work duplication
description: Revisit metadata handoff, path construction, staging, permission finalization and copy/removal work after existing optimizations. Reuse existing observations where the chosen action needs them.
acceptance_criteria: Source census distinguishes delivered work from remaining duplication; tiny operation-count experiments support selected changes.

title: Design inherited subtree assessment shortcuts
description: Specialize recurse tips into Compare, CopySource, RemoveTarget, Preserve or simpler residual assessors. Treat all descendants versus most-with-exceptions explicitly.
acceptance_criteria: Design states saved comparisons/policy calls, required source I/O and pause granularity; whole-directory operations can expose resumable inner steps.

title: Assess cursor archive representation and reconstruction cost
description: Use first-demo evidence to assess kopacetic Facet-row/rkyv versus direct typed rkyv and packed-name cursor components. Keep codec choice isolated from traversal semantics.
acceptance_criteria: Small captured cursor samples establish size/allocation or reconstruction observations, schema/parameter fit and tradeoffs; no large benchmark campaign or unsupported zero-copy claims.

title: Define overwrite removal and preservation semantics
description: Independent foundational research: source-present updates, target-only deletion, preserved regions, ignoredness and classification before/after snapshot. Broad donor copy and mirrored deletion are separate choices.
acceptance_criteria: A concrete policy matrix and scenarios expose open human decisions without silently selecting new defaults; links to existing creation/reseed/prepare behavior.

title: Design minimum fact acquisition for assessment and execution
description: Independent foundational research: listing facts versus stat/readlink and handler-required attributes; avoid constructing every fact for every possible consumer.
acceptance_criteria: A demand table and examples show what I/O can be omitted and what copying still requires; maintains actual presence independently of selected work.

title: Investigate borrowed dirent components and packed name storage
description: Inspect native RawDir and std paths. Compare borrowed OsStr/Path/component views, packed arenas and offset sorting against current OsString allocation/cloning. zerocopy or custom unsafe parsing is permitted where justified.
acceptance_criteria: Source-backed lifetime/layout account plus bounded allocation/syscall experiment; compare safe baseline and native alternatives; no transmute into an incompatible owning PathBuf.

title: Design extensible resumable action dispatch
description: Resolve descriptors into registered handlers with parameters, child tasks, finalization and serializable inner state. Keep a small useful protocol rather than an unbounded plugin framework.
acceptance_criteria: Copy, generation and mapping scenarios specify what dispatcher and handler each own, including unknown descriptor behavior and pause within a subtree.

title: Design virtual entries and path mappings
description: Investigate generated bytes/recipes, logical input providers, emitted tasks, remapped coordinates and child-derived output. Decide collision behavior for generated and copied outputs sharing a destination.
acceptance_criteria: Physical, generated and mapped examples share a credible model; serialization includes required generator/mapping state without faking filesystem observations.

title: Design observations attributes actions and recurse modes
description: Independent foundational research into physical facts, domain annotations, chosen work and child progression. Compare current Action enum with extensible handler/version/parameter descriptors. Do not add a redundant disposition layer by habit.
acceptance_criteria: Small examples demonstrate equal physical inputs requiring work, compound directory actions and open handler payloads; pure Visitor and ordered driver responsibilities are explicit.

title: Design component-built cursor construction
description: After first-demo evidence and execution-model research, design a builder for roots, observer, assessor, handlers/config, traversal state and codecs. Separate fresh construction from restoring captured parts. Consider bon for typed builder ergonomics.
acceptance_criteria: Concrete Rust usage shows fresh builder and restore-from-parts, defaults and ownership; the next walking demo can implement it without core serialization dependencies.
notes: Parent review of completed demo: current Cursor is a public Facet DTO with start/validate/advance, not a component builder. Restore validation is filesystem-free, including terminal state: preserve that separation. NoVisitor is fixed, and reduce deliberately explores every directory side; configurable policy must not accidentally reuse that all-directory reduction when PreserveTree was selected. Builder/step design should distinguish portable stored parts from process-local observation/handler implementations. Baseline /examples/cursor/src/cursor.rs and /design/cursor/implementation0.gpt61sxh.md; opencode://ses_ea82cf969ffeAXqmUxHChTJar2.

title: Build a component-built pause and resume walking demo
description: Follow the current demo with an explicit step/pause/serialize/deserialize/resume walk using the reviewed builder. Exercise unfinished children and direct construction from components; avoid replaying a consumed prefix.
acceptance_criteria: Actual process-boundary tests match uninterrupted ordered results and retain intermediate frame state; demonstrate builder and from-parts usage.

title: Design step and entity-completion semantics
description: Independent foundational research: distinguish assessment unit, traversal tip, pre-order effects, post-order completion, active frames, accumulators and retry/skip. Failure promises no rollback or effects journal.
acceptance_criteria: Model handles small leaf/directory/generated examples and states which components must survive serialization; identifies conflicting API choices.

title: Trustworthy development and performance evidence
description: Make tests and measurements attributable while implementation evolves: isolated fixtures, pinned artifacts and bounded experiments.
acceptance_criteria: Native tests cannot escape fixture repositories; evidence identifies executables/revisions/features; experiments use proportional verification.

title: Git and JJ workspace identity adapters
description: Keep generic copying independent of Git/JJ while correctly preserving or constructing native metadata and resolving workspace lifecycle facts.
acceptance_criteria: Topology cases, registered-missing identity and graph intent are explicit; integration reuses generic mechanisms and preserves selected native identity.

title: Explicit transfer semantics and work avoidance
description: Decide preservation, overwrite and deletion semantics, then specialize recursion and share useful donor work.
acceptance_criteria: Policy choices precede production changes; subtree, kernel and multi-target proposals name saved work and remaining costs.

title: Extensible actions and generated tree content
description: Separate observed facts from selected work; support parameterized handlers, virtual content and mappings without depending on a fixed mirror-only vocabulary.
acceptance_criteria: Observation/action/traversal contracts compose; generated and mapped cases have explicit representations and dispatcher ownership.

title: Demand-shaped facts and efficient path representations
description: Investigate minimum observation work, borrowed dirent names, packed storage and cursor serialization costs.
acceptance_criteria: Concrete facts/lifetime contracts and bounded allocation/syscall evidence select or reject representation changes.

title: Composable stepping and continuation
description: Define how assessment, child traversal, accumulated state and completed entities compose, including component construction and process-to-process continuation. Preserve the running snapshot demo.
acceptance_criteria: A component-built walking specimen exercises explicit pause/resume without prefix replay; ownership and promotion boundary documented.
